A '''Rebel Base''' on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:RebelMilitaryBase.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Rebels were forced to relocate from their old base on Tatooine to avoid Imperial detection.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] learned of the location of the [[Rebel Military Base (Tatooine)|Rebel Military Base]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], forcing the Rebellion to pack up its base and move elsewhere to avoid Imperial detection. Rumor had it that they relocated to [[Rori/Legends|Rori]],<ref name="P1" /> the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Indeed, the Rebels did relocate their base to Rori, northwest of its [[Lake Octir]]. The base, just like its predecessor on Tatooine, was shaped in the form of the [[Alliance Starbird]].<ref name="SWG:RB" />

The Rebel Base soon became a contested hotspot in the Galactic Civil War and Imperial and Rebel forces fought several times for the control of the base. Imperial forces managed to capture the base several times but the Rebel Alliance had always taken it back.<ref name="StW" />

The same year, a spacer infiltrated the base and stole an [[Obsidian sword]].<ref name="SWG:RMWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Base on Rori appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The Rebel Base was added to ''Star Wars Galaxies'' during the game's first large update, the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]," released on [[August 13]], 2003.<ref name="P1" /> The old base on Tatooine was remodeled by the developers to appear destroyed, and a new base was put on Rori. The same graphical model for the intact base on Tatooine was used for the new base on Rori.<ref name="SWG:RB" /><ref name="SWG:RMB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Rebel Military Base|Tatooine}}</ref> In game, no explanation was given for why the Rebels relocated from their base on Tatooine to the newly built one on Rori, but the patch notes offered an explanation. According to the notes, the Rebels packed up the Tatooinian base in order to avoid Imperial detection.<ref name="P1" />

The Rebel Base was a "Factional NPC Base". Groups of Imperial players could attack Rebel NPCs and achieve several objectives to take control of the base.<ref name="StW" />
